No clue what I'm in the mood for, unless I do a basic mozzarella / tomatoes / basil. .

A real nice simple one to make is a hosin duck pizza. This recipe is a good starting point to go from: http://www.epicurious.com/recipes/food/views/duck-pizza-with-hoisin-and-scallions-356569 Though i normally add some cheddar and whole onion along side. Also; unless you have an extremely thick duck brest; dont pre cook it in the oven, just generously sear each side then shread. It will finish cooking when you place the whole pizza in the oven; else your duck will become dry. Although if you are doing big chunks of duck, I expect it will be fine to use the method in the recipe.
